purpose: Dedicated diffuse/albedo map for Authority Nexus ivory tower sides
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one seamless square diffuse/albedo material texture for the ivory armored SIDE PANELS of the Authority Nexus wormhole hub, for direct UV mapping on a low-polygon 3D model.

Create a 1024 by 1024 pixel texture image, completely filled edge to edge with the MATERIAL ITSELF. This is NOT a picture of a station or a tower, NOT a concept sheet, NOT a floating object, and NOT a rendered sphere. Straight-on, perfectly flat orthographic view of a broad expanse of finely engineered metal armor.

Material and style: sophisticated Art Deco science-fiction station armor, warm pale ivory titanium/ceramic cladding over gunmetal structural seams, very restrained thin brushed-brass inlay strips. Match the refined, worn-but-well-maintained civic spaceport style of the Authority Nexus. The ivory should be slightly cool gray in some plates and warm cream in others, with believable subtle tonal variation. Do not turn the texture yellow, beige stone, concrete or marble.

Panel design: a coherent pattern of moderately sized interlocking narrow rectangular armor plates, mainly vertically oriented, with a few stepped angular shoulders and chamfered corners. Fine charcoal recessed panel seams, narrow secondary engraved lines, tiny dark fasteners, subtle shallow bevels, a few understated maintenance access panels with no writing. Arrange the rhythm in elegant long vertical bands, interrupted by occasional short horizontal seams. Include a small number of very thin muted brass decorative engineering strips; most of the area remains ivory armor. Dense enough for interesting details on a large tower side without looking like a busy circuit board. Avoid enormous blank regions. No huge central motif or large black ventilation hole.

Surface finish: very fine brushed-metal grain, restrained micro scratches and slight gray grime at recesses and corners. Barely worn, not rusty. Broad diffuse uniform illumination across the WHOLE image: no directional cast shadows, no bright specular highlights, no vignette, no lighting gradient, no ambient background. Only subtle local seam/bevel shading is allowed. The material should tile seamlessly on all four edges with no border.

No station silhouettes, no towers, no coils, no pipes or cables lying over the material, no lights or emissive strips, no cyan or violet glowing elements, no space scene, no stars, no text, symbols, numbers, decals, logos, watermark, scale bars, interface or extraneous objects. Deliver the flat production texture only.
